run.description: Full run of the Campus Customs agent team on the three open tickets, after resetting data/campus_customs_new.db to the original values.
run.model: gpt-6-luna (Portkey, OpenAI Responses API) for all five agents

tickets.short_outcome: No size S tee on the shelf (0 of 1). The only apparel vendor, Bulldog Print Co, was blocked by overdue invoice #501 ($840, 3 days overdue). Accounting put #501 up for approval, the owner approved it, and the vendor can now reprint (5-day lead). Customer draft #1 tells Tauhid the honest timeline. The ticket waits on the vendor.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, delegated to Inventory, Accounting and Customer Service, checked cash, set status waiting_on_approval with an audit note, and returned the final call. It ran out of output tokens once at the end and was finalized by the one-time no-tools retry.
agents.inventory: check_stock(CC-TEE-WHITE, S, 1) found 0 on hand, short 1. get_vendor_status found Bulldog Print Co (apparel, 5 days) blocked by #501.
agents.accounting: get_invoice(501) confirmed $840, open, 3 days overdue, blocking. get_cash_position showed $3,400. request_payment created request #1 for $840.
agents.customer_service: Saved draft #1 to Tauhid Zaman (not sent).

drafts.subject: Update on your Bulldog tee
drafts.body:
Hi Tauhid,

We don’t have the CC-TEE-WHITE tee in size S available right now. We’re arranging a restock with our supplier, but it can’t proceed until an outstanding step is approved. Once that’s cleared, the supplier’s lead time is 5 days; we’ll follow up with a firm arrival date. Nothing has shipped or been reserved yet.

— Campus Customs, Chapel Street

tickets.short_outcome: Facilities checked the landlord's email against lease #1: $2,400 due 2026-09-02, 2 days after the shop date, not overdue. Accounting requested the rent, the owner approved it, and the lease's next_due moved to 2026-10-02.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, delegated to Facilities and then Accounting, checked cash ($160 left if both requests are paid), recommended paying #1 first and then rent, and set status waiting_on_approval.
agents.facilities: get_rent_status(1) found $2,400 due 2026-09-02, 2 days out, not overdue. The email matches the lease.
agents.accounting: get_cash_position and get_rent_status(1), then request_payment created request #2 for $2,400. It flagged $160 left after both requests.
agents.customer_service: Not called (the landlord is not a customer).

tickets.short_outcome: 20 size-M hoodies asked for, 8 on hand, 12 short. Boss approved the standard 15% bulk discount on the 8 available ($49.30 each, 55.4% margin, $394.40 for 8). The 12-unit reprint ($264 at cost) was not ordered: the vendor was blocked by #501, and cash after the pending requests was only $160, $104 short. Draft #2 to the club states the offer. Board status stays in_progress until the club replies and a restock can be funded.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, delegated to Inventory, Accounting and Customer Service, made the discount call (15% within policy), and set status in_progress.
agents.inventory: check_stock(CC-HOOD-NAVY, M, 20) found 8 on hand, short 12. get_vendor_status found Bulldog Print Co blocked by #501. It was called twice: once by Boss and once again by Accounting.
agents.accounting: quote_bulk_price for 8 at 15% ($49.30, 55.4%) and 8 at 20% ($46.40, 52.6%), and 12 at 0% (restock cost $264). get_cash_position showed $160 after pending requests. get_invoice(501). It created no payment request because the purchase order doesn't fit the cash. It also delegated to Inventory (an extra hand-off).
agents.customer_service: Saved draft #2 to the Yale AI Club with the 15% offer on 8 units (not sent).

drafts.subject: Update on your hoodie request
drafts.body:
Hello Yale AI Club,

We can currently offer 8 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M at the approved 15% bulk discount: $49.30 each. The other 12 aren't available yet. They depend on our supplier becoming available to restock; once unblocked, the reported lead time is 5 days. Nothing has been reserved or ordered, so we can't confirm when those 12 will be available. We'll follow up with a firm update.

— Campus Customs, Chapel Street

tickets.why_no_purchase_order: Restock of 12 x $22 = $264 > $160 cash left after the $840 and $2,400 requests. The pay tool would refuse it, and the vendor was blocked by #501 at decision time.
